difficulty_reason: A public connection's OAuth flow works without any review; the optional Marketplace listing is a separate step with a 5-10 business day review.
setup_time: ~15 minutes for the connection; listing adds 5-10 business days of review

approval.kind: none for OAuth use; optional Marketplace listing review
approval.wait: none for OAuth; 5-10 business days if you list
approval.notes: Notion states public connections work independently of Marketplace listings and can be used via their OAuth flow without being listed. Listing is purely for discovery.

summary: Refreshingly decoupled: you create a public connection and its OAuth flow works immediately - no approval to use it in production. Submitting to the Notion Marketplace for discovery is optional, reviewed by the Notion team in 5-10 business days. The one irreversible decision is installation scope: only connections set to Any workspace at creation can ever be listed.

steps.title: Create a connection
steps.detail: Go to the connections dashboard (notion.so/developers/connections - the old /my-integrations URL now redirects here) and create a public connection.

steps.title: Choose installation scope carefully
steps.detail: Set installation scope to Any workspace if you might ever want a Marketplace listing. The scope is fixed at creation and cannot be changed afterward.

steps.title: Configure OAuth
steps.detail: Set the redirect URI(s), copy the client ID and secret, and your OAuth flow is ready to use - no approval gate.

steps.title: (Optional) Build the Marketplace listing
steps.detail: Under Listings > Connections, start a new listing with name, description, category, tags, images, logo, and the associated public connection. Save as draft and edit freely before submitting.

steps.title: (Optional) Submit for review
steps.detail: Submit from the listing page; the Notion team reviews and responds by email within 5-10 business days. Track status under Listings > Connections; if changes are required, update and resubmit.

requirements: For listing: installation scope of Any workspace, listing images and copy
nuances: Installation scope is set at creation and cannot be changed - internal or Selected workspaces only connections can never be listed.
The long-standing console URL notion.so/my-integrations now redirects (301) to notion.so/developers/connections.
A rejected listing comes with emailed feedback; you can fix and resubmit.
common_blockers: Creating the connection with the wrong installation scope and discovering it cannot be listed later - you would need a new connection.
agent_can_do: Draft the listing name, description, category and tags
Check your listing copy against Notion's Connection Gallery best practices
human_must_do: Create the connection while logged in
Submit the listing and respond to Notion's feedback

evidence.claim: Public connections work independently of Marketplace listings and can be used via their OAuth flow without being listed; listing is optional.
Only public connections with installation scope Any workspace are eligible for the Marketplace, and installation scope is set at creation and cannot be changed afterward.
After submitting a listing, expect to hear back from the Notion team within 5-10 business days via email; status is tracked on the Listings > Connections page.
https://www.notion.so/my-integrations redirects (HTTP 301) to https://www.notion.so/developers/connections, observed 2026-10-20 - older tutorials citing the former are outdated.

uncertainties: Notion does not publish what percentage of listings are approved or common rejection reasons beyond the general categories (brand/trademark, quality, baseline criteria).
